description: Respond to an open RFQ with your price. Opens a private deal thread with the creator; returns the threadId for negotiate/deal_status. price = TOTAL quote-asset amount for the whole base amount (not per-unit). Your quote is your acceptance of that price (as the initiator, this tool accepts it for you with your hashlock): when the creator accepts it, the deal is agreed.
name: respond_to_rfq
